content.text: Hypertensive crisis (acute severe hypertension): SBP ≥180mmHg &/or DBP ≥120mmHg
» Hypertensive urgency (severe asymptomatic HTN): hypertensive crisis without signs of acute end-organ damage
S/SXS: asymptomatic or isolated, nonspecific symptoms (e.g., HA, dizziness, epistaxis)
TX: immediate BP reduction not required; reinstitute/intensify PO antihypertensive therapy
reduce BP to <160/100 over hours to days w/ PO antihypertensive (e.g., clonidine or captopril)
TX: admit to ICU for IV antihypertensive therapy; reduce BP ≤25% within 1st hour, then to <160/110-100 over next 2-6h, & back to baseline over next 24-48h
